description: Oxford 3000 verb lemmas scored by Borda-style points from: high-freq-2000 rank, unigram_freq.csv rank (by count), 1 lemmas-Table 1.csv rank (best rank per lemma); small bonus if lookup_key appears in efdotcom-mostcommon-3000.txt.
